calls.title: Alyssa / Scott
calls.summary: The meeting addressed several key areas including the preparation for the sales enablement deck for sales 5.0 during bi-weekly meetings, emphasizing tactical demand generation. There were discussions on improving the Growth Book demo, which faced bugs during the last presentation, along with a follow-up call planned with Graham and Fixer for enhancements. The tone of blog posts was critiqued as too dry, with plans to utilize AI for drafting and include more authors for diverse styles. Additionally, challenges with Webflow CMS limitations were noted, prompting a potential migration to Next.js or Astro for better site performance. The adoption of Obsidian was highlighted for knowledge management, with a shift from Craft and enhanced customization using plugins and AI. Lastly, Fireflies video capabilities for downloads were confirmed, with tests planned ahead of potential shifts to Streamyard.
calls.keywords: sales enablement, product marketing, Growth Book 5.0, webflow CMS, demo improvements, Obsidian notes
